one_line: One unedited take of a real child doing the activity, under a headline that states the result.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 a boy about 5 in profile at a wooden table runs a finger over a colourful grid chart. Headline: "ככה לימדתי את בן ה-5 שלי לקרוא לבד 🥰". In-scene sound: he reads a syllable (transcript "יא").
q1_hook.why: The result is already on screen: a child reading, under a headline that states the outcome and who did it (H2, H1, T3). No adult face or voice (H4), and the hook is in text, not in speech (H6). A child's face on screen is what LumeBook's own Reels should avoid (S5).

beats.what: Boy in profile, finger over the chart; headline on; he reads a syllable
beats.why: Outcome and proof in the same frame.

beats.what: He smiles at 0:04, reads another syllable; an adult says "מעולה" (transcript)
beats.why: A smile and praise make the moment warm.

beats.what: Finger moves across rows, he keeps reading; headline leaves at about 0:13
Same framing with no text; more syllables (transcript "סא", "פא") and "מעולה"
beats.why: Repeats the same proof, nothing new.

beats.what: He smiles at 0:21, reads again, lifts his hand and looks ahead at 0:24
beats.why: A soft end, no closing line or ask.

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: Caption only: "לקבלת לינק כתבו בתגובות ״לינק״⬇️". Nothing in the video asks to comment, send or save.
q2_flow.why: Syllable after syllable with a smile and praise is warm and believable, but after the headline leaves at 0:13 the same picture runs 11 s with nothing added (R3, R1). Calm pride, not a peak moment (K1), and it stops without a payoff line (R4). A real child's reaction is the pull (K8).

q3_cta.what: None in the video, nothing said or on screen. Caption: "לקבלת לינק כתבו בתגובות ״לינק״⬇️", after the price "(120₪ כולל משלוח!)" and the claim "הכי טובה בישראל".
q3_cta.why: One keyword that delivers a link (C3, C1), but only in the caption's fourth line. The video ends with no ask, so a viewer moved by the child has nothing on screen to act on (C6). Price and delivery appear together in the caption (S3).

q4_shown.what: A boy about 5, face visible in profile, reading syllables from a letter-and-vowel chart under his finger, for the whole Reel. An adult off-camera is heard praising (transcript). No box, cards, booklet, brand or price on screen.
q4_shown.why: The child using the product from 0:00 is checkable proof, in one steady shot (S1), backed by a first-person claim, "לימדתי" (S6). The reading is shown as single syllables, not words (K4). The kit, brand and price are not on screen, so as product content it is invisible (C7, H3).

q5_edit.what: One handheld take of 24.7 s, no cuts, no speed change. The framing drifts and widens a little. The headline stays 0:00 to about 0:13, then no text. Natural sound of the child reading. Ends as he lifts his hand and looks ahead.
q5_edit.why: A single take reads as real and costs nothing (E6, E7). But with no cut or new text after 0:13, the second half is one picture for 11 s (E2, R3). The in-scene sound carries the proof (E4). It ends abruptly, with no payoff or ask (E8).

q6_topic.what: A parent's claim that she taught her 5-year-old to read alone with a syllable kit, named only in the caption. Serves a parent wondering how to start reading.
q6_topic.why: Learning to read before school is a real concern for parents of 5-year-olds (K6). The outcome claim "לקרוא לבד" is stronger than the syllables shown (K4). The caption adds superlatives, "הכי טובה בישראל" and "המלצת זהב", which are hype (K6).

q7_filmed.what: Handheld phone at table height, side-on to a boy in profile in a bright living room, window light. The chart sits cropped in the lower left, the boy's face at the right edge. The framing drifts. The filmer is off camera.
q7_filmed.why: A real home and daylight give the native look (H8, F7). But the chart is small and cut by the left edge, unreadable at phone size (F4), and the face touches the right edge (F2). It is a side view, not the product-first top-down of hands (F5).

q8_text.on_screen: One two-line headline, white bold with a dark outline, centred at about 50 to 55% down, from 0:00 to about 0:13: "ככה לימדתי את בן ה-5 שלי לקרוא לבד 🥰". Nothing else: no subtitles for the reading, no brand, no price, no CTA.
q8_text.caption: "מצאתי את ערכת לימוד הקריאה לילדים הכי טובה בישראל,". About 55 words: the superlative, "120₪ כולל משלוח!", the contents, five stars, the keyword ask, and "בשיתוף @pashut.alef.bet" on the last line. No hashtags.
q8_text.why: A short headline states the result in big clear type, held 13 s (T3, T5), but it then vanishes and nothing in the video names the kit. The caption supplies brand, contents and a full price with delivery (S3, T7), yet the partnership line comes last, under "more" (S7, T8).

weak_points: Kit, brand and price never on screen; the headline leaves at 0:13; no CTA in the video; the chart is small and cropped; a child's face on screen; the partnership line only at the end of the caption; superlative claims.
lumebook_takeaway: One steady top-down take of hands turning the book, a result headline held to the end, the CTA on screen; no child's face.
not_verified: Whether the chart is part of the kit (the caption lists a booklet, letter cards, memory aids and a bag); who says "מעולה" (transcript); that she is the boy's parent (headline only); whether the partnership was paid or gifted (no label, the caption says "בשיתוף"); the transcript's "על הסופיות לדרג" is a mishearing; music (none evident). Correction to the first pass: the child's face is visible in profile all through, only the creator's face is absent. Plays 35,321, likes 293, comments 353 on 15 Oct are context only.
